def simulate(active, inactive, move):
    seeds = active[move]
    new_active = active[:]  # shallow copy
    new_inactive = inactive[:]
    new_active[move] = 0
    pos = move + 1
    extra = False
    last_pos = None
    last_side = None
    while seeds:
        if pos == 13:
            pos = 0
        if pos == 6:
            new_active[6] += 1
            seeds -= 1
            if not seeds:
                extra = True
                break
        elif pos < 6:
            new_active[pos] += 1
            seeds -= 1
            if not seeds:
                last_pos = pos
                last_side = 'active'
        else:  # 7..12
            idx = pos - 7
            new_inactive[idx] += 1
            seeds -= 1
            if not seeds:
                last_pos = idx
                last_side = 'inactive'
        pos += 1
    if not extra and last_side == 'active':
        # capture
        if new_active[last_pos] == 1 and new_inactive[5 - last_pos] > 0:
            new_active[6] += new_active[last_pos] + new_inactive[5 - last_pos]
            new_active[last_pos] = 0
            new_inactive[5 - last_pos] = 0
    return new_active, new_inactive, extra
